arguments.message:
Hi! The contact importer matches columns by header name, not by position, so the order of your columns doesn’t matter as long as the headers match. The required headers are **email**, **name** and **company**. Optional headers include **phone**, **title** and any custom field that already exists in your workspace – just use the custom field’s own name. Any header the importer doesn’t recognise will be ignored, so an extra column won’t block the import.

If you want to be 100 % sure, download the sample template from the import screen – it shows the exact header spelling the importer expects. Also, exporting as CSV is the safest default for compatibility, though it will treat dates and numbers as plain text.

Let me know if you need help with the template or anything else!
